name: The Stone of Golorr (External Knowledge)
description: A highly coveted artifact at the center of the 'Grand Game' in Waterdeep, relentlessly hunted by the city's major criminal and political factions[cite: 3, 4].
key_facts: Former Open Lord Dagult Neverember embezzled half a million gold dragons, hid them in the Vault of Dragons, and used the Stone to erase and store the memory of the vault's location[cite: 3].
Neverember blinded the Stone by gouging out its three eyes and scattering them across the city to secure his secret[cite: 3].
The gnome Dalakhar stole the blinded Stone from the Xanathar Guild but was killed in Trollskull Alley by a Nimblewright dispatched by Lady Yalah Gralhund[cite: 3, 4].
The Blackstaff, Vajra Safahr, and her agents classify the Stone as a 'Class-Alpha Cognitohazard' and a biological containment unit, ordering it to be kept in a lead-lined box[cite: 2, 4].
The three missing eyes are currently held by the Xanathar Guild, the Cassalanter noble family, and the Manshoon-led Zhentarim[cite: 3].
gm_notes: Use this lore when NPCs like Renaer, the City Watch, or rival factions talk about the Stone. They don't know it's an Aboleth; they just know it's a dangerous key to a fortune that kills anyone who holds it too long.
